title: TeraWulf announces Anthropic has signed a 20-year lease for a data centre in development at its Justified Data campus in Kentucky
summary: Yahoo Finance carried the announcement of 6 July, listed on Wikipedia's Anthropic entry.

title: UN Global Dialogue on AI Governance is scheduled to hold its first session in Geneva on 6 and 7 July
summary: Wikipedia's entry on AI regulation says the session is co-chaired by Egriselda Lopez of El Salvador and Rein Tammsaar of Estonia.

title: Russia's State Duma passes its first AI law, covering foundation models above 1 billion parameters; it takes effect on 1 September
summary: The law keeps 'sovereign' and 'national' model categories, drops the 'trusted' registry and mandatory labelling, and lets users flag AI content on platforms with over 500,000 daily Russian users.

title: Axios dates OpenAI's public release of GPT-5.6 in its Luna, Terra and Sol versions to 9 July
summary: The release followed the rollout deferral announced on 26 June; Wikipedia's ChatGPT entry notes that its version table gives a different, June, date.

title: US eases export curbs on the UAE, naming G42 an authorised recipient of certain advanced AI chips without individual licences
summary: Bloomberg reports the reclassification of the UAE under US export rules; Wikipedia's G42 entry says the authorisation applies under specified conditions.

title: Researcher Tinh Dang reports Grok Build uploaded users' full repositories, including API keys, to SpaceXAI storage even with 'Improve the model' switched off
summary: SpaceXAI changed a server setting later that day and Musk promised to delete the data; on 16 July Grok Build was released as open-source software under the Apache licence.

title: AMD and Anthropic announce a partnership to deploy up to 2 GW of AMD MI450 GPUs, with AMD investing up to USD 5B in Anthropic
summary: AMD's press release is listed on Wikipedia's Anthropic entry under July 2026 without a day.

title: Federal judge grants final approval to the USD 1.5B authors' copyright settlement with Anthropic
summary: Wikipedia's Anthropic entry names Judge Araceli Martinez-Olguin and dates the approval only to July 2026.

title: DeepSeek reportedly starts talks on a new funding round at a USD 70B pre-money valuation, the South China Morning Post reports
summary: Wikipedia's DeepSeek entry also lists Bloomberg and Financial Times reports of 14 July that DeepSeek began IPO preparations, with a listing possible as early as 2027.

title: Indian parliamentary panel summons Meta officials over child-abuse material in Instagram ads and deepfake content; Zuckerberg apologises
summary: Wikipedia's Meta Platforms entry lists the summons of the committee on communications and IT under July 2026 without a day.

title: Intel announces a USD 5.7B expansion of its Leixlip campus for AI and high-performance computing chips
summary: Wikipedia's Intel entry says completion is expected by the end of 2027 and dates the announcement only to July 2026.

title: Thinking Machines Lab releases Inkling, a 975B-parameter open-weights model under the Apache licence
summary: Reuters reports the launch; Wikipedia's Moonshot AI entry says Inkling was reported to be post-trained from Kimi models.

title: TSMC reports a 77% rise in Q2 profit and lifts its 2026 capex forecast to USD 60-64B on strong AI chip demand, Reuters reports
summary: Wikipedia's TSMC entry gives July 2026 without a day and adds a further USD 100B US investment, taking its planned US total to USD 265B.

title: Moonshot AI releases Kimi K3, a 2.8T-parameter open-weights model described as the largest open-weights model
summary: Wikipedia's Moonshot AI entry dates the release to 16 July and links the company's blog; IT Home had reported teaser videos on 15 July.

title: Shanghai hosts the 2026 World AI Conference and a High-Level Meeting on Global AI Governance, 17 to 20 July; CCTV says Xi Jinping will give the keynote
summary: CCTV previews say over 1,400 guests, 140+ forums and 1,100+ exhibitors; Xinhua says ten bodies co-host, including the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. These are pre-event statements, not outcomes.

title: Xi Jinping announces a World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization (WAICO) at the World AI Conference in Shanghai
summary: Wikipedia's page on China's AI industry lists the announcement under July 2026 without a day or membership details.

title: Alibaba unveils a preview of Qwen3.8-Max, a 2.4-trillion-parameter flagship model, Bloomberg reports
summary: Wikipedia's Qwen entry says Alibaba then announced it would release the weights, which followed on 12 August.

title: Reuters: Hugging Face used a self-hosted Z.ai open-weights model to contain the OpenAI agent attack after US proprietary models refused its requests
summary: Wikipedia's Hugging Face entry says the model was Z.ai's GLM-5.2; the report treats the episode as a cost of US model guardrails.

title: Anthropic launches Claude Opus 5, TechCrunch reports
summary: The launch of 24 July is listed on Wikipedia's Anthropic entry.

title: Google pulls its Nano Banana image feature from Google Earth within 24 hours after users generated altered disaster and military imagery
summary: Newsweek, the New York Times and The Atlantic covered the backlash over generated misinformation, per Wikipedia's Gemini entry.

title: DeepSeek releases the official V4-Flash; a research firm later finds it by far the cheapest well-known model to run, Reuters reports
summary: Wikipedia's DeepSeek entry dates the release to 31 July and cites Reuters of 3 August for the cost finding, which is the research firm's.

title: US House committees request information from DoorDash about its use of Chinese AI models, CNBC reports
summary: Wikipedia's Moonshot AI entry says the body text dates the committees' subpoenas to April 2026.
